fields.name: live magic
fields.meaning: Same 15-byte marker as the saved copy, written into the live area just before every save (taken from ROM)
fields.evidence: code 6000:4145 (copies ROM 9000:16a8 to 0000); differs only at the save step

fields.name: live game area (not the save itself)
fields.meaning: Battery memory 0000-26FF is the game's working memory for the whole adventure (flags, money, items, characters, map). It is NOT the save: the game copies it to 5900 when you save and copies it back on Continue. Field meanings below are given at saved-copy offsets (live offset = saved offset - 5900)

fields.name: work memory (not saved)
fields.meaning: Scratch memory used during play (screen and window state, sound, input); changes every frame, never copied into the save. Cleared together with everything else at power-on when there is no valid save
fields.evidence: changed bytes on nearly every play step; not in copy range of 6000:4145

fields.name: name-check counter
fields.meaning: Small record (AC, counter, flag, XOR check) that the game updates at power-on after comparing the console owner's name with a list of 8 names in ROM; lives in work memory, so it only survives while a valid save keeps the memory from being cleared
fields.evidence: code 3000:58d0 bank EF (compare 2e10=AC, xor check, table 3000:596e); boot reads at 3000:58e3/58ec

fields.name: save magic
fields.meaning: Fixed marker "000925190422" + 00 FF 00 (looks like a build date 2000-09-25 19:04:22). A save counts only if this matches and the checksum matches; otherwise all 32 KB are cleared at power-on
fields.evidence: code 6000:41cb (compare vs ROM 9000:16a8); boot clear 6000:0ef0-0f04; boot reads 6000:41eb

fields.name: zero padding
fields.meaning: Always zero in every save image

fields.name: story flags
fields.meaning: Event/story flags, one bit each: flag n is bit (n AND 7) of byte 5930 + n/8 (32768 flags). Set, cleared and tested by event scripts. In the early natural save flags 10, 20, 100 and 102 are set
fields.evidence: code 6000:71f6 test / 6000:720e set / 6000:721c clear, base 0x30 in 6000:723a; cleared at new game (6000:7280); set during opening events

fields.name: money
fields.meaning: Money shown in the field menu; reduced by price x quantity when buying
fields.evidence: code 5000:c3bb (subtract), 5000:c420 (afford check), 6000:1906 (new game = 0); field menu shows 0 and value is 0

fields.name: reward total
fields.meaning: 24-bit total that grows after battles/events by an amount the battle code leaves in console memory, capped at 300000; 500 in the natural saves (set during the opening events)
fields.evidence: code 6000:1723 (add capped at 0x493e0), 6000:1906 (new game = 0); 0 -> 500 during opening

fields.name: inventory item ids
fields.meaning: Item numbers of the normal inventory (ids below 5B), 0 = empty slot; all empty in the natural saves
fields.evidence: code 5000:afea / 5000:b01c (search 1036 for 0x30 entries, count at +0x30); cleared 6000:7280; battle write-back 6000:1723

fields.name: inventory counts
fields.meaning: How many of each item in the slot above

fields.name: key item ids
fields.meaning: Item numbers of important items (ids 5B and up), 0 = empty

fields.name: key item counts
fields.meaning: Count for each important item slot

fields.name: character records
fields.meaning: 22 records of 61 bytes, one per character id 1-22 (record = 69C6 + (id-1) x 61). Pre-filled from a ROM table at new game, then initialised field by field
fields.evidence: code 6000:71c4 (index 10c6+(id-1)*0x3d), 6000:7280 (copy 0x53e bytes from ROM), 6000:1906 (field init); set at new game

fields.name: zero padding
fields.meaning: Always zero in every save image

fields.name: new-game marker
fields.meaning: Set to 4 when a new game starts; purpose not known

fields.name: zero
fields.meaning: Always zero

fields.name: map id
fields.meaning: Current map: 0000 corridor/temple areas, 0100 town area, 0280 first room

fields.name: position X
fields.meaning: Hero tile X; +2 walking right 6 steps, -3 walking left 6 steps

fields.name: position Y
fields.meaning: Hero tile Y; -2 walking up 6 steps

fields.name: camera X
fields.meaning: Camera/scroll tile X, follows the hero (clamped per map)
fields.evidence: moves with X, offset differs per map

fields.name: camera Y
fields.meaning: Camera/scroll tile Y, follows the hero
fields.evidence: moves with Y, offset differs per map

fields.name: zero
fields.meaning: Always zero

fields.name: step counter
fields.meaning: Changes on every step (animation/step counter); loading a save clears the low 2 bits of the high byte
fields.evidence: diffs on every step; code 3000:038c clears bits on load

fields.name: zero
fields.meaning: Always zero

fields.name: room-load flag
fields.meaning: 0xFE once right after the first room loads, else 0

fields.name: constant 0x08E7
fields.meaning: Fixed value once play starts (0 before); purpose not known

fields.name: zero
fields.meaning: Always zero

fields.name: field byte
fields.meaning: Set to 0 together with the word below

fields.name: zero
fields.meaning: Always zero

fields.name: field word 100
fields.meaning: Always 100 during play

fields.name: field word 1000
fields.meaning: Always 1000 during play

fields.name: zero
fields.meaning: Always zero

fields.name: map flag
fields.meaning: 1 only while on map 0100, else 0

fields.name: current map data
fields.meaning: Data of the map you are standing on (attribute bytes, then 16-bit tile entries); rebuilt whenever the map changes and restored as is on Continue. Attribute bit 7 marks visited tiles
fields.evidence: rebuilt on every map change; restored by 6000:419e; bit 7 set on newly visited tiles

fields.name: console memory snapshot
fields.meaning: Copy of console internal memory 00D0-059E (the running game's own variables: party, menu state, play counters) taken at the moment of saving and copied back on Continue
fields.evidence: code 6000:4333 (copy 0000:00d0 -> 2190 len 0x4cf), 6000:4354 (copy back); differs between saves

fields.name: ROM bank numbers
fields.meaning: The two ROM bank registers in use when saving (E4 and EF), restored on Continue

fields.name: zero padding
fields.meaning: Always zero in every save image

fields.name: checksum
fields.meaning: Checksum over 5900-7FFD: start with two zero bytes A (low) and B (high); for each byte: B = 2xB, A = A + byte, B = B + A (all 8-bit). Stored as A, B. Recomputed on three distinct saves; all match

fields.name: shared-record order
fields.meaning: Recency list for the 7 shared records the console's internal memory holds for linked games (0 = most recently written). After saving, record 1 is 0 and the others 6
fields.evidence: code F000:01d9 via F000:0020 call 0x0b; set at the save step

fields.name: reserved
fields.meaning: Zero

fields.name: shared record 1: game key
fields.meaning: Key 6 = this game's link record
fields.evidence: code F000:01ae (search key in words 6,12..42), 3000:587e passes key 6; set at the save step

fields.name: shared record 1: progress flags
fields.meaning: Bit list written on every save for other games to read: bits 0-21 = story flags 9001-9022
fields.evidence: code 3000:02ae bank EF builds it; all zero in the early natural saves

fields.name: shared record 1: reserved
fields.meaning: Always 0 (no flag writes target this byte)

fields.name: shared record 1: progress bits
fields.meaning: Byte 4: bits 0-3 = owning items 70, 72, 6F, 71, bits 4-6 = story flags 8050-8052, bit 7 = story flag 8000

fields.name: shared record 1: reserved
fields.meaning: Always 0

fields.name: shared record 1: version
fields.meaning: Always 8

fields.name: shared record 1: check
fields.meaning: XOR of the 9 bytes before it
